current_competition.name: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra

facts_checked.task: Rank up to 25 SMILES candidates per test molecule from LC-MS/MS spectra
facts_checked.metric: MRR@25, using tautomer canonicalization under RDKit 2026.03.3 followed by the first InChIKey block
facts_checked.runtime: Notebook submission, internet disabled, CPU or GPU notebook up to nine hours

current_competition.consequence: An offline CPU SQL audit is a plausible deployment target. Competition equivalence must retain the pinned official normalization; the latest generic RDKit documentation or DuckSMILES canonicalization is not a substitute. This is a proposed fit, not an integration verified in a Kaggle notebook.

local_missingness_evidence.meaning: 158 molecule queries whose fixed baseline 10-ppm retrieval set did not contain the correct structure, among 2242 development molecule queries. These are not 158 missing assay observations, spectra, or NULL labels.
local_missingness_evidence.important_limits: All 158 true structures had records in the existing frozen F001/COCO/BIO catalogues. Cause classification uses labels only after label-free candidate sets were written and hashed; it cannot be used as a label-free test-set quality rule. Candidate coverage is separate from top-1/MRR. No automatic adduct correction or window widening is justified by this report.

local_missingness_evidence.meaning: Historical 109-feature incompleteness for 551 candidate rows, not 551 molecules or spectra: 525 unsupported adduct rows and 26 outside the 10-ppm mass-support range.
local_missingness_evidence.limit: Different population and level from the 158 molecule-query retrieval diagnostic; do not sum these counts.

local_missingness_evidence.reuse: Existing flags distinguish NULL arrays, empty arrays, unequal lengths, nonfinite peaks, nonpositive m/z, negative intensities, unsorted m/z, peaks above precursor, invalid precursor, missing adduct, and reported-count mismatch; no source rows or peaks are removed.
local_missingness_evidence.limit: These are diagnostic flags; an above-precursor flag or formula-text difference is not by itself proof of an invalid physical measurement. Preserve the original rule severity until a charge/measurement-specific contract is validated.

local_missingness_evidence.reuse: Existing CE interpretation retains eV/NCE/percent/V/unknown separately and records conversion=not_performed; test structures are intentionally NULL in the staging view.
local_missingness_evidence.limit: Source-not-reported metadata must not be inferred to mean not-measured. Test labels withheld by competition design must not be treated as ingestion defects or imputed. Missing spectral peaks are not automatically below-LOD observations.

confirmed_reuse.confirmed: AssetCheck supports named SQL and eq/gt/lt/between/not_null expectations. The executor evaluates the first column of the first row, stores pass/fail plus actual scalar and run ID, and error-severity failures mark the task/materialization failed for downstream skip propagation; warn only logs.
confirmed_reuse.proposed_use: Orchestrate materialized chemical findings assets, then run scalar count/coverage gates over the findings.
confirmed_reuse.missing: The inspected check contract has no per-record chemical reason schema, unresolved/unsupported state, rule-version snapshot, raw-value/bounds/units contract, or chemistry validation policy. Historical check results join the current check definition rather than storing immutable historical expectation/severity.

confirmed_reuse.confirmed: Named assets, materializations, lineage and partition parameters exist. SQL task code_version uses FNV-1a 64-bit. Ingestion has nested JSON normalization and a schema-difference module.
confirmed_reuse.proposed_use: Bounded per-source/shard QC runs, dependency ordering and run lineage. Reuse current Parquet/DuckLake views rather than reingest or duplicate large CASMI raw files.
confirmed_reuse.missing: FNV task fingerprint is not a cryptographic input/artifact audit. Add explicit SHA256 and snapshot/version references in the proposed DQ run evidence. Chemical semantic drift is distinct from structural schema drift. Same-process DuckOrch plus DuckSMILES ABI compatibility was not tested.

confirmed_reuse.confirmed: Public registrations expose mol_is_valid, mol_formula, mol_exact_mass, formula_exact_mass, canonical_smiles, mol_hash, scaffolds, largest_fragment, strip_salts, neutralize_charges, normalize_smiles and fragment_parent. Adduct inverse/forward mass functions return SQL NULL for unsupported or invalid inputs.
confirmed_reuse.proposed_use: Fast CPU parse/property/explicit-adduct checks and derived identity candidates, with backend and policy version recorded.
confirmed_reuse.missing: The inspected bool validator returns parse success without a rich issue list. Supported native graph/canonicalization is not proof of RDKit MolStandardize or official CASMI equivalence. Existing InChIKey helpers validate/split supplied keys, not evidence of official tautomer-normalized key generation. NULL must be diagnosed as source missing, unsupported label, invalid numeric input or failed computation rather than flattened to a single missing bucket.

confirmed_reuse.component: Existing CASMI identity, structure and leakage audits
confirmed_reuse.confirmed: Official identity overlay preserves raw/legacy keys, official code SHA and pinned RDKit version. Structure QC stores charge, component count and neutral-assumption support without modifying original structures. Grouped split logic checks source row, content hash and held official identity; newer training-member checks reject content components crossing fold/role/protection.
confirmed_reuse.proposed_use: Wrap and report existing validated derivations as DQ assets; do not silently replace the official identity backend or recompute archived full data.
confirmed_reuse.missing: Each script's declared population/version must remain explicit. A slice-only split audit is not full-train leakage clearance; matching hashes or multiple distributors do not prove distinct physical measurements.

primary_references.finding: Provides validation, cleanup, charge/fragment parents, tautomer normalization and PipelineResult stages/status/logs, including structure-modification events. Use as a reference for separating diagnosis from transformations.
primary_references.limit: Current generic docs are not the contest-pinned RDKit 2026.03.3 contract. No package was installed or invoked.

primary_references.finding: Separates checker, standardizer and parent generation. Checker returns issues and severity penalty; parent/standardization methods can change the representation. This supports keeping check findings and proposed corrections distinct.

ChEMBL flags questionable type/unit/range, activity comments, target-assignment confidence and potential duplicates. Identical compound/target/activity/type/unit may be a duplicate flag; assay context still matters.
Published units are retained and separately standardized. Biological assay type and target relationship confidence are distinct metadata.

Recommends explicit blank/exclusion reasons and retaining flags. Qualifier definitions are not universal. Censored observations require method/laboratory-specific detection or quantification limits, and left/right/interval censoring differ. Automatic zero/half-limit replacement can distort analysis.
primary_references.scope_limit: Water-quality source: reuse the information-preservation principle, not its qualifier-code table as a universal chemical assay dictionary.

primary_references.finding: Detection limit concerns distinguishing a result from blank with stated probability; it need not equal the lower end of a quantitatively determinable range.
primary_references.access: Official PDF indexed in search; HTML endpoint returned 403, so no additional HTML detail was assumed.

primary_references.finding: Original molecular benchmark distinguishes random, scaffold and time splits. A split policy must match the intended generalization question; scaffold grouping alone does not establish every form of leakage is absent.

proposed_missingness_contract.principle: Different axes, not a single NULL reason enum. Preserve raw evidence and use unknown/not_reported when the source does not establish a more specific reason.
minimum_preserved_fields: field/endpoint, raw_value_text, numeric_value, observation_status, qualifier_raw and qualifier_dictionary_version
relation (=,<,<=,>,>=,interval,unknown), lower_bound, upper_bound, lower_inclusive, upper_inclusive, censoring_type
unit_raw, unit_canonical, conversion_policy/version/status, original and derived values separately
LOD, LOQ and upper analytical limit with their units and method/source provenance where available
assay/sample/method/instrument/source/batch/time and endpoint-specific conditions; MS includes polarity, adduct, charge/multimer interpretation and CE raw/unit/pattern
raw structure/identifiers, native derived representation, official normalized identity key, backend/version/policy and computation reason
examples: Reported <5 nM keeps a left-open/closed bound according to the source relation, not numeric_value=0 or 2.5. An assumed lower bound of zero is allowed only for a nonnegative endpoint contract.
Detected but below LOQ may be an estimated measured value, an interval, or an unknown point depending on source documentation; the letter J alone does not fix the meaning.

An assay failure is not a nondetect. Missing metadata is not evidence that the condition was not measured. An absent MS/MS peak is not a per-analyte nondetect without an acquisition/reporting contract.
Unspecified stereo, a salt and a mixture are structure-level information states. They need not make a measured concentration or spectrum missing.
NCE and eV remain different units. Mass-to-molar conversion needs the correct molecular form/molar mass. A decreasing transform such as pIC50 reverses inequalities and swaps bounds.
Test structures withheld by design remain outside imputation/quality-failure counts. Unsupported adduct conversion is a computation-support issue, not proof the original adduct is wrong.

proposed_architecture.flow: Existing immutable source views -> versioned interpretation sidecars -> DuckSMILES/official-backend derivations -> record-level findings -> grouped summaries and scalar DuckOrch asset gates -> immutable audit manifest
proposed_architecture.duckorch_role: DAG, retry/partition/run tracking, asset dependency and lineage, scalar severity gates
proposed_architecture.ducksmiles_role: Bounded CPU molecular parse/property/explicit supported-mass calculations; optional transform proposals stored separately
proposed_architecture.existing_casmi_role: Reuse official normalization, source IDs, spectrum-content hashes, data eligibility and fold/feature exposure evidence
new_rule_spec: rule_id, rule_version, population/field, required metadata, applicable backend/policy version, SQL predicate/measurement, severity, unsupported behavior, independent reference fixture
new_findings_table: dq_run_id, rule_id/version, source_record/field, status(pass/fail/warn/not_evaluated/unsupported), reason_code, raw/derived evidence, bounds/units/conditions references, optional correction_proposal_id
new_audit_run_table: input manifest SHA256 and snapshot, complete rule spec SHA256, code/extension/compiler or environment versions, identity/units policy, denominators and not-evaluated counts, output artifact SHA256, execution timing/status
proposed_architecture.correction_policy: Detection emits findings only. Any future correction writes a new derived column/table plus original value, transformation policy and provenance; structure parents, charge neutralization and censored-value substitutions are never silent repairs.
proposed_architecture.important_gap: DuckOrch's existing scalar check history does not provide this immutable record-level contract. A proposed thin integration can persist findings as ordinary DuckDB tables and gate their aggregate counts without initially changing DuckOrch's engine.

recommended_first_product.name: CASMI chemical input and computational-support audit, CPU SQL/JSON sidecar
scope: Raw field/array and provenance checks, preserving input rows and peak lists
Adduct/charge/multimer/precursor and CE-unit interpretation support matrix, with source missing versus unsupported versus invalid distinguished
Structure parse, component/charge/formula and identity-policy diagnostics using existing native/official backends separately
Same-identity/source-row/content-component overlap across current folds and supervised feature/model membership; keep measured versus derived/generated provenance
Candidate-generation coverage diagnostics for labeled development data only, with label-free outputs frozen before truth audit and every empty/unsupported query retained in the denominator
initial_acceptance: Independent fixtures distinguish source NULL, empty list, nonfinite value, unsupported adduct and invalid numeric input; no unexplained NULL becomes a pass
Equivalent units and relations produce consistent canonical bounds, and decreasing transforms reverse inequalities correctly; unknown dictionaries remain not_evaluated
Two raw aliases sharing an official identity never cross identity groups; content components crossing folds are reported even when IDs differ; genuine condition-specific repeats are retained
Reproducing existing aggregates must preserve exact populations: 551 candidate-row feature support gaps and 158/2242 molecule-query positive absences are separate reports
Source hashes, scalar fields, list values and row identities remain unchanged; outputs are finite valid JSON and reference input/rule/backend snapshots
Prove actual DuckOrch and DuckSMILES can load in the same supported DuckDB version before claiming integrated deployment; verify one bounded public SQL run and its persisted findings/audit linkage
recommended_first_product.later_generalization: Assay concentration/LOD/LOQ qualifier adapters, rule dictionaries for ChEMBL/environmental/ADMET datasets, and explicit correction proposals can follow. CASMI's current mass-spectra task does not by itself demonstrate demand for an assay-censoring engine.

open_uncertainties: Which other current competitions matter to the user; CASMI26 is confirmed locally and publicly, not claimed to be exclusive
Exact currently installed/published DuckOrch and DuckSMILES versions and same-DuckDB ABI compatibility
Source-specific LOD/LOQ/assay failure dictionaries and whether these fields are available in the user's future non-CASMI datasets
Chemical validation issue taxonomy and breadth of native parser/normalization support versus the selected RDKit/ChEMBL reference version
Which existing CASMI derived tables are locally present versus archived; no large archive was restored for this research
No assertion that flags or a wider search window improve ranking or should alter live data; integration and product implementation remain future authorized work
